sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: Evaluating Graph RAG systems requires metrics that go beyond standard RAG evaluation because the retrieval mechanism is **graph-structured** — meaning we must assess not just whether the answer is correct, but whether the **right entities, relationships, and graph paths** were retrieved and used. Standard RAGAS metrics (faithfulness, answer relevance, context precision) can be adapted, but Graph RAG introduces additional dimensions: **entity recall** (did retrieval find the correct entities?), **relationship precision** (were retrieved relationships relevant?), **graph path accuracy** (was the reasoning chain through the graph correct?), and **community summary faithfulness** for global search. Evaluation is typically performed offline using a **test set of (query, expected_entities, gold_answer)** triples derived from labelled documents. Production evaluation uses **LLM-as-judge** (GPT-4o) to score faithfulness and relevance automatically at scale.

  │         → {answer, entities_used, context}         │
